source.name: Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace
source.widthNote: Published range; 13.5 m is an inferred nominal width, not a pointwise survey.
source.elevationNote: Reconstructed 56 m height range. The range is sourced; the longitudinal profile and intermediate heights are inferred, not surveyed.
source.runoffNote: Default gameplay runoff: 20 m of grass on each side, editable per zone. This deliberately differs from real-world safety areas, especially at street circuits.
source.layoutNote: The municipal operator publishes a 56 m elevation range and 12–15 m width. Formula Timer describes about 40 m elevation; the reconstructed profile uses the operator range. Its 15-corner catalog count is retained despite alternative corner numbering.
